title: Detail column: a title, a green name line, ruled rows each with an icon, a 23-unit sub-head and 16-unit body; the first row red for the role
use: The right column of a detail screen (mode, operator, vehicle) or an in-game info panel.

body_1.default: 突击干员拥有更快的冲刺与换弹速度，可携带破片榴弹与震撼弹。

sub_2.default: 战术装备 - 推进护腿

body_2.default: 短时间内大幅提升冲刺速度，冲刺中开镜不受减速影响。

sub_3.default: 战术道具 - 破门炸药

body_3.default: 贴附在门与薄墙上远程起爆，炸开一条新的进攻路线。

sub_4.default: 干员特长 - 疾行换弹

body_4.default: 移动中换弹速度提升，不会打断冲刺。

relations: Column 500 wide; title 36 bold, name line 16 green, a 1-unit rule at 104.
Rows 112 high, ruled; sub-head 23 bold (the role row red, the others green), body 16 on a 24 line; icons 40-48 in a 60-unit column.
